_comment: M11's pre-registration: SPEC/11's claim, its pinned values, its five falsifiers and its validity checks, as data. REVISED after M11 PR 2's seat round (ADR-080 amendment 1), superseding the version committed first in PR 2: SPEC/11's validity table gained one row (each run's caption bytes are the committed fixture's), and every falsifier and validity row is now carried verbatim as `spec_row`. Committed AFTER the re-taken `readers.txt`, which shows every reader named here emitting a value on synthetic fixtures at the committed code (CLAUDE.md, Milestone discipline; ADR-080 decision 1). `tests/test_drill_pins.py` holds this file equal to SPEC/11's tables and pinned section and to `drill/scenarios/caption-check.json`. Nothing here may change after the registration this PR carries at its head (SPEC/11, What must not happen; ADR-080 amendment 1). On AI Quality, Platform Engineering and Security. REVISED AGAIN at M11 PR 2b, after the cold review (ADR-080 amendment 4): the seeded, control and fixed validity rows each gain a `drill verify` clause, carried verbatim from SPEC/11, and F3's liveness `on_failure` now reads INVALID. No pinned value, falsifier or reader moved, so `readers.txt` stands.
claim: For event jefferson-derby at tier 3, a seeded caption failure makes `pave drill` write a NO-GO. The NO-GO names the seeded gap, the pinned owner, and a fix-by time set by the pinned window, under a signature that refuses a hand edit. The delta drill run without the fix still writes NO-GO for the same gap. The delta drill run with the fix writes GO.

falsifiers.name: the seed is not caught
falsifiers.false_if: decision is not NO-GO, or the findings are anything other than exactly the seeded finding
falsifiers.spec_row: | **F1** | **the seed is not caught.** Seeded: `decision` ≠ `NO-GO`, or the findings are anything other than exactly `caption-check/max-gap/c006/c008` | `decision`, `finding` | `python -m pave.cli drill read` | lands in **PR 2** |

falsifiers.name: the NO-GO names the wrong owner or time
falsifiers.false_if: owner.seat, owner.oncall or fix_window_s differs from its pin on either run
falsifiers.spec_row: | **F2** | **the NO-GO names the wrong owner or time.** Seeded or control: `owner.seat` ≠ `service-team`, `owner.oncall` ≠ `webhook:player-captions`, or `fix_window_s` ≠ `129600` | `owner.seat`, `owner.oncall`, `fix_window_s` | `drill read` | lands in **PR 2** |

falsifiers.name: a hand edit survives
falsifiers.false_if: any edited copy of the seeded artifact for which verify does not exit 1 printing `signature: MISMATCH`

liveness.why_not_evidence: one key and one canonical form make it true by construction
liveness.on_failure: INVALID: SPEC/11's seeded validity row requires verify on R1 to exit 0 printing signature: OK, so a failed liveness check makes the seeded run INVALID and no copy is read (ADR-080 amendment 4, item 2, superseding amendment 1 item 2's not registered)

edits.made_with: sed, one substitution on a copy
sed, one substitution on a copy
sed, one substitution on a copy

falsifiers.plant_live: cmp shows each copy differs from the seeded artifact
falsifiers.spec_row: | **F3** | **a hand edit survives.** Three copies of R1 are made, each with one `sed` substitution and shown by `cmp` to differ from R1: `decision` to `GO`; `owner.oncall` to `webhook:someone-else`; `fix_by`'s year plus one. The claim fails on any copy for which `verify` does not exit 1 printing `signature: MISMATCH` | `signature` | `python -m pave.cli drill verify` | lands in **PR 2**. `sed` and `cmp` exist **today** |

falsifiers.name: the control is not NO-GO for the same gap
falsifiers.false_if: decision is not NO-GO, or its finding lines differ from the seeded run's
falsifiers.spec_row: | **F4** | **the control is not NO-GO for the same gap.** Control: `decision` ≠ `NO-GO`, or its `finding` lines differ from seeded's | `decision`, `finding` | `drill read` | lands in **PR 2** |

falsifiers.name: the fix does not yield GO
falsifiers.false_if: decision is not GO, or any finding line
falsifiers.spec_row: | **F5** | **the fix does not yield GO.** Fixed: `decision` ≠ `GO`, or any `finding` line | `decision`, `finding` | `drill read` | lands in **PR 2** |

validity._comment: Read before any falsifier. A run failing one is INVALID: the claim is NOT MEASURED, M11 closes RED, and no run is repeated. B is PR 3's branch point on main; S, C and F are the commit fields of the seeded, control and fixed artifacts; R1 is the seeded artifact's path. Each row is SPEC/11's, verbatim.

rows.spec_row: | all three | `tree_clean=true`. `caption_sha256` equals `git show <commit>:drill/fixtures/jefferson-derby/captions.vtt \| sha256sum`, the fixture at the run's own `commit` (ADR-080 amendment 1). S, C and F lie in that order on PR 3's branch (`git merge-base --is-ancestor`) | `drill read`, `git show`, `sha256sum`, `git` | PR 2, today |

| seeded | `mode=full`. `git diff --name-only B S` is exactly the fixture. `drill verify` on R1 exits 0 printing `signature: OK`, and `signature.key_id` equals the first 16 hex of `milestones/M11/pre-registration/key.sha256` (ADR-080 amendment 4) | `git diff`, `drill verify`, `grep '"key_id"'` on R1, `head -c 16` on `key.sha256` | PR 2, today |

| control | `mode=delta`. `prior_sha256` equals `sha256sum R1`. `caption_sha256` equals seeded's. C ≠ S. `git diff --name-only S C` lies under `milestones/M11/`. `drill verify` exits 0 (ADR-080 amendment 4) | `drill read`, `drill verify`, `sha256sum`, `git diff` | PR 2, today |

| fixed | `mode=delta`. `prior_sha256` equals `sha256sum R1`. `git diff --name-only C F`, minus `milestones/M11/`, is exactly the fixture. `git diff B F -- drill/fixtures/jefferson-derby/captions.vtt` is empty. `drill verify` exits 0 (ADR-080 amendment 4) | `drill read`, `drill verify`, `sha256sum`, `git diff` | PR 2, today |
